module: Node "Time" (category provider, no flow). Provides the current time. Outputs: time (os.clockhp(), high-precision clock), dtReal (real time between frames in s, ignores pause), dtSim (simulated time in s, 0 when paused, reduced in slow motion).
notes: The description of the time pin says "Time since start of project" but the value is the absolute clock os.clockhp(), not the time since start.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

work.desc: Writes os.clockhp() to time and mgr.dtReal / mgr.dtSim to the other two outputs.
